prior_importants.description: After the revert, the skill still asks for prior_importants as {file, line, description, status} and never says how to number entries, while the schema and poster now require {from, index, status} with index counting every element; a model that counts only owed entries makes the poster and metrics resolve the wrong carried important.

The prior record is parsed all-or-nothing against today's schema: a pre-#258 record (schema_version 6) whose prior_importants entries lack `description` fails to parse, so the poster carries nothing (not even the record's own findings importants), the body can read "No issues found", and the metrics step records prior_importants: [], losing them for every later round.

findings.description: A pre-schema-7 prior record now parses with description "", so carriedLines (review-body.utils.ts:146-148) renders a carried bullet like `src/x.ts:39-40` (correctness): with nothing after the colon, and the metrics step copies the "" into every later record until resolved; a placeholder in carriedLines (e.g. `entry.description || "description not recorded in the prior review"`) would tell the author which finding is owed without touching the record.
